title: Update the time of a split test
content_data:
Use this endpoint to update the start time and end time of a split test. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/split_test/update/ **Method** POST **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token{Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | |split_test_group_id {Required} | string | Split test group ID. | |start_time {Required} | string | The start time of this split test, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (UTC+0). Example: 2022-01-01 00:00:00.

Note:

  • For campaign level split tests,
    • The time can only be set to hour level. Thus, any MM and SS input will default to 00.
    • The start time set for campaign level split test will not overwrite the start time of campaigns and ad groups in this test.
  • For ad group level split tests, the start time of the test will be applied to both ad groups under this test group.
  • For both campaign and adgroup level split tests, the start time cannot be updated once the test has started.
| |end_time {Required} | string | The end time of this split test, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS(UTC+0). Example: 2022-01-01 00:00:00.

Note:

  • For campaign level split tests,
    • The time can only be set to hour level. Thus, any MM and SS input will default to 00.
    • The end time set for campaign level split test will not overwrite the end time of campaigns and ad groups in this test.
  • For ad group level split tests, the end time of the test will be applied to both ad groups under this test group.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/split_test/update/' \ --header 'Access-Token: xx' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data-raw '{ "advertiser_id": "xx", "start_time": "2022-10-21 22:00:00", "end_time": "2022-10-22 22:00:00", "split_test_group_id": "xxx" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object| Returned data. | |request_id|string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "xxx", "data": {} } (/code) ```
